Class FlatPatch

java.lang.Object
imageproof.FlatPatch
public class FlatPatch extends Object
Finds solid-colour patches (like a Paint fill) in an otherwise noisy image.

Camera noise makes real photos almost never contain a 4 x 4 block of exactly equal gray values, but a solid fill does. The rules are:

  • A block is flat when all 16 pixels are equal and the value is not 0 or 255 (clipped shadows and highlights are naturally constant).
  • A patch is a group of at least MIN_BLOCKS connected flat blocks with the same value. Blocks touch if they are next to each other, also diagonally. The patch must contain a solid 3 x 3 block core (12 x 12 pixels), so thin text bars and strokes are ignored.
  • The test only runs when at least MIN_NOISY_SHARE of the blocks are not flat, because noise-free art, screenshots and heavily smoothed JPEGs contain flat areas naturally. It does not run on JPEG files at all, or on images with fewer than MIN_GRID blocks.

Limits: text and thin strokes are ignored. A fill that was blurred, noised or re-compressed afterwards is not flat any more. A patch is a measurement, not proof of editing. TamperingAssessment uses the result.
